title: Integrated Pest and Nutrient Management for Tomato in Kolar & Chikkaballapur Districts
institution: ICAR - National Institute of Agricultural Engineering and Technology & UAS Bangalore

pest_disease_guidance.issue: Early Blight and Late Blight (Phytophthora / Alternaria)
pest_disease_guidance.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots on lower leaves with concentric rings, rapid leaf drying
pest_disease_guidance.organic_remedy: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L or 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE)
pest_disease_guidance.chemical_remedy: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 to 2.5 g/L water or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L
pest_disease_guidance.safety_notes: Wait 10 days before harvest after Mancozeb spray. Wear protective mask and gloves. Strictly avoid unapproved or restricted Class I chemicals.

pest_disease_guidance.issue: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) via Whitefly vector
pest_disease_guidance.symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, stunted plant growth, bushy appearance
pest_disease_guidance.organic_remedy: Yellow sticky traps @ 15 traps/acre. Spray neem oil (1500 ppm) @ 3 ml/L
pest_disease_guidance.chemical_remedy: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 to 0.5 ml/L water during early vegetative stage only
pest_disease_guidance.safety_notes: Strict limit: 0.5 ml/L maximum. Toxic to bees. Do not spray during peak flowering or pollination hours.

soil_nutrition.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 10 kg/ha basal, Boron foliar spray @ 1 g/L during flowering

title: Standard Operating Package for Bt Cotton in North Karnataka & Raichur Black Soils
institution: ICAR - Central Institute for Cotton Research & UAS Raichur

pest_disease_guidance.symptoms: Rosetted flowers, exit holes in green bolls, stained lint
pest_disease_guidance.organic_remedy: Pheromone traps @ 8 per acre for monitoring. Release Trichogramma parasitoid wasps @ 60000/acre
pest_disease_guidance.chemical_remedy: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L
pest_disease_guidance.safety_notes: Never exceed recommended dilution. Strictly avoid unapproved or restricted chemical formulations.

pest_disease_guidance.issue: Leaf Reddening and Magnesium Deficiency in Deep Black Soils
pest_disease_guidance.symptoms: Interveinal purpling and reddening of mature leaves, shedding of squares
pest_disease_guidance.organic_remedy: Soil application of FYM (Farm Yard Manure) @ 5 tonnes/ha prior to sowing
pest_disease_guidance.chemical_remedy: Foliar spray of Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4) @ 10 g/L (1%) along with 1% 19:19:19 water soluble fertilizer
pest_disease_guidance.safety_notes: Spray during late evening hours to maximize foliar absorption.

soil_nutrition.micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha in zinc deficient black soils

title: Soil Health Management and Nutrient Optimization for Cauvery Basin Sugarcane
institution: University of Agricultural Sciences, Bangalore & Zonal Agri Research Station Mandya

pest_disease_guidance.symptoms: Dead hearts in young shoots that emit foul smell when pulled out
pest_disease_guidance.organic_remedy: Trash mulching @ 3 tonnes/acre at 3-5 days after planting to conserve moisture and suppress borer
pest_disease_guidance.chemical_remedy: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 2.0 ml/L directed towards root zone
pest_disease_guidance.safety_notes: Ensure soil has adequate moisture prior to drenching. Wear gloves and rubber boots.

soil_nutrition.micronutrients: Ferrous Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha if interveinal chlorosis appears
